definition: A spare goal kept ready for slow moments or when a main goal stalls. No fixed order: pick the one that fits the moment.
The list of words and phrases set to be blocked or banned in chat. Load the current version on every room.
A live-cam platform. "CB-only" means the stream runs on that platform alone (not MTS).
OF subscribers gained ÷ average viewers × 100. A better measure of a good stream than viewer count alone.
The team that handles fan messaging. After each stream, operators hand over verified fan context to them.
Holding something back on cam so viewers want to see more elsewhere. The room is a funnel, not a show.
Silence or no interaction on stream. Avoid it with prompts and fillers.
How many viewers actually take part and tip. A smaller room of active tippers beats a huge room of lurkers.
The report filed after each stream with verified results, strongest and weakest moments, and next steps.
A short scene or activity used in slow moments to keep the room engaged (games, songs, questions).
The call before a new creator's first stream to confirm expectations, persona, privacy, schedule, goals and process.
Moving interested viewers to OF. Only on shown interest, using approved, platform-safe wording.
The planned order of goals for a stream, with token amounts. Built with push and pull.
A 🚩 post in the creator's operator channel for disruptions, safety, privacy or major tech issues. One thread per stream day.
The four labels for lessons carried into the next stream after the post-stream review.
One of the planned goals for the stream (usually 4). The biggest one is placed early while energy is high.
Streaming to several platforms at the same time. Track traffic, engagement and revenue per platform.
The streaming software. Check the scene, camera source, preview and audio before every stream.
The subscription platform that streams funnel viewers to.
A ready-made line for the model. "+" means a line to say; "++" means an action to do.
The post-stream write-up of results, learnings and the plan for next time. Verified data only.
1) Goal amounts: easy goals first, then high to low. 2) In-stream: tease and hold back, then re-engage.
The official operator performance score, recorded on the SOPI form for every stream. (Add the full name.)
The team of operators and TLs who run creator streams.
A live internet speed test on the model's actual device, done before every stream.
The short update posted when something is delayed or changes, so everyone knows what is happening and why.
The single stream-plan reference shared by the model and the operator.
Rotating room tags. Aim to rank #1 in tags you can win rather than crowd into the most popular ones.
Owns a group of operators and models: reviews, coaching and escalations.
Definition to be added.
A viewer who tips big amounts. Give them a personal thank-you without ignoring the rest of the room.
